**MODE: /polish**

**INPUT: incident response team we have a critical operational post-mortem and mitigation plan for the kafka cluster partition leader rebalance failure during yesterday's traffic surge.**  

**FIRST EXAMINATION:**  
- Verify that auto-leader-rebalance-enable is set to true and that leader-imbalance-per-broker-percentage is configured to one percent.  
- Confirm the primary root cause was an unexpected network partition between availability zones us-east-1a and us-east-1b, causing twenty-four brokers to simultaneously trigger leader elections across two thousand partitions.  
- Check the kafka-core slash partition assignor dot java in the kafka-core directory and inspect the controller dot py in the cluster-manager package.  
- The primary cause was an unexpected network partition between availability zones us-east-1a and us-east-1b, leading to twenty-four brokers triggering leader elections across two thousand partitions.  
- During the cascading election phase, message production halted because min-insync-replicas was set to three while replica lag exceeded replica-lag-time-max-ms of ten thousand milliseconds.  
- To remediate this cascade, tune zookeeper session timeouts from eighteen seconds to six seconds and adjust group-initial-rebalance-delay-ms from three seconds to zero seconds for low latency consumer group handoffs.  
- Update controller dot py to ensure partition state machine transitions throttle concurrent leader reassignments to fifty partitions per second rather than unconstrained batch elections.  
- Under no circumstances should any engineer modify the unclean-leader-election-enable setting to true, as that would risk catastrophic data loss across financial audit logs.  
- The principal systems architect requires that all broker nodes configure socket-send-buffer-bytes to one megabyte and socket-receive-buffer-bytes to one megabyte to prevent tcp buffer starvation under high load.  
- Confirm that consumer applications using the java client library implement backoff retries using exponential jitter starting at two hundred milliseconds capped at five thousand milliseconds.  
- Incident coordinators should review the runbook in docs slash runbooks slash kafka underscore rebalance dot md to verify manual topic partition rebalancing commands specify explicit throttle rates.  
- The observability team must establish automated grafana alerts triggered when under-replicated-partitions count exceeds zero for more than three consecutive minutes.  
- Verify that all broker nodes emit jmx metrics to datadog tracking active controller count and offline partition count with zero second reporting intervals.  
- The data platform engineering manager confirmed that all storage volumes must maintain twenty percent free disk space before resuming high throughput bulk ingestion pipelines.  
- Network engineers must inspect edge load balancers to ensure tcp keepalive probes are enabled with an interval of thirty seconds and probe count of three.  
- In addition, verify that consumer group heartbeat threads execute on dedicated high priority cpu cores to avoid false positives during heavy garbage collection pauses.  
- The billing ingestion pipeline must configure consumer max-poll-interval-ms to three hundred thousand milliseconds to accommodate long running batch database transactions.  

**DO NOT EXECUTE BOOKING RESTRUNS DURING PEAK BUSINESS HOURS**  
- All schema registry client libraries must enable local in-memory schema caching with a maximum capacity of ten thousand schemas.  
- In addition, security operations must audit ssl certificate expiration dates across all broker nodes and ensure automated rotation thirty days prior to expiration.  
- Site reliability engineers will execute simulated broker failure drills in staging next tuesday morning to validate partition rebalancing completion in under forty-five seconds.  
- The backup and disaster recovery team must confirm mirror maker two replication lag between primary and secondary cloud regions remains below two seconds.  
- Log segment compaction threads must be configured with min-cleanable-dirty-ratio set to zero point five to avoid excessive disk io during active hours.  
- Client application connection pools must enforce idle connection timeouts of sixty seconds to prune orphaned tcp sockets.  
- The platform security team requires mutual tls authentication between all producers and brokers using certificates issued by our internal vault pki.  
- Incident leads must also ensure post-incident action items are tracked in jira with assigned engineering owners and target completion dates within two sprints.  

**REQUIREMENTS:**  
- Architectural readiness review scheduled for friday morning at ten am with the infrastructure director.
